# Unlock IQ Institute Pvt. Ltd.

> Pune-based education company conducting academically structured, online maths and reasoning olympiads, quizzes and assessments for school students of Classes 1–11 in India. Programmes are independent academic enrichment programmes (not conducted or endorsed by CBSE, NCERT, PARAKH or any government body).

## Programmes (2026-27)
- [Aryabhatta Maths Olympiad (AMO)](https://www.unlockiqinstitute.com/olympiads/aryabhatta-maths-olympiad/): A two-stage international maths olympiad that rewards deep, stepwise thinking on classroom topics. Classes 1–11; fee ₹250; exam L1: 24–25 Apr 2027.
- [REAL Olympiad (REAL)](https://www.unlockiqinstitute.com/olympiads/real-olympiad/): A single-stage reasoning olympiad that develops the logic and aptitude no single school subject teaches. Classes 1–11; fee ₹250; exam 18 Apr 2027.
- [Ramanujan Maths Quiz (RMQ)](https://www.unlockiqinstitute.com/olympiads/ramanujan-maths-quiz/): A multi-test maths series that builds mastery — and gives every child a detailed diagnostic picture of strengths and gaps. Classes 1–11; fee ₹400 per level; exam 1–7 May 2027.
- [UNITE Olympiad (UNITE)](https://www.unlockiqinstitute.com/olympiads/unite-olympiad/): The olympiad that comes to your school — an inter-school maths and reasoning event scheduled around your calendar. Classes 1–11; fee ₹500; exam Nov / Dec / Jan.

## Also
- Schools: UNITE Olympiad and a school-branded Mathematical Ability Assessment with student and school reports.
- Shop: AMO and REAL practice-paper sets (personalised PDFs, released class by class), REAL Olympiad books, Mathemagica (Vedic maths), table games, bookmarks, KG activity books and worksheets.
